notes: A.1 item 53: 'DISPLAY directive (conversion of data transferred). This item is required. This item shall be documented' (§7.3.12 GR1). §7.3.12.4 GR1: 'Any conversion of data required is defined by the implementor.' cite.py --check 7.3.12.4 -> OK §7.3.12.4 1). docs/CONFORMANCE.md has NO '| DOC-A.1-53 |' row; the only text (line 526) says >>DISPLAY 'transfers text to the (absent) source listing / compile-time device, so it is recognized and consumed' — no conversion is stated. Code: directive consumed with no transfer, no state (DirectiveStateRegistry 'NONE HELD'); probe '>>DISPLAY "HELLO-COMPILE" 42' at --std 2023 compiles clean, emits nothing at compile time, run prints only RUN; at --std 2014 -> COBOLNET0900 (edition gate correct: DISPLAY directive is a 2023 addition). The code fixes a behavior (operands are never evaluated or transferred, so no conversion) but the required determination is missing -> DIVERGES (silent). Owning note: kb/Work/PB1369 (open; title names item 53) — referenced, not re-reported.

A.1 item 54: 'DISPLAY directive (meaning of compile-time-device-1). This item is required. This item shall be documented' (§7.3.12 GR5). §7.3.12.4 GR5 b): 'if compile-time-device-1 is specified, data is transferred to the device defined by the implementor for receiving that data.' cite.py --check 7.3.12.4 -> OK §7.3.12.4 5). No '| DOC-A.1-54 |' row; CONFORMANCE.md:526 only calls the device '(absent)' and defines no compile-time-device-1 name; any word in that position is accepted silently and nothing is transferred. Behavior fixed (no device, consumed) but required determination missing -> DIVERGES (silent). Owning note: kb/Work/PB1369 (open, names item 54); the undiagnosed device-name syntax is PB807's.

A.1 item 55: 'DISPLAY directive (mechanism for providing the value of a compilation-variable-name from the operating environment). ... shall be documented' (§7.3.12 GR3). §7.3.12.4 GR3: 'the value referenced by compilation-variable-name-1 is obtained from the operating environment by an implementor-defined method ... If no value is made available from the operating environment no transfer shall take place.' cite.py --check 7.3.12.4 -> OK §7.3.12.4 3). No '| DOC-A.1-55 |' row and CONFORMANCE.md:526 never mentions PARAMETER; probe '>>DISPLAY PARAMETER XYZ' compiles clean with no transfer (the 'no value, no transfer' half holds vacuously) but the mechanism is neither defined nor documented -> DIVERGES (silent). Owning note: kb/Work/PB1369 (open; its GR-7.3.12.4-3 refutation names item 55).

A.1 item 60: 'Dynamic-capacity table (determination of highest permissible occurrence number). This item is required. This item does not have to be documented' (8.4.2.3). §8.4.2.3.4 GR2: 'The highest permissible occurrence number for any given dimension of a dynamic-capacity table is implementor-defined and may be affected by the availability of runtime resources. If the value of the subscript is not a positive integer or is less than one or is greater than the highest permissible occurrence number, the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist.' cite.py --check 8.4.2.3.4 'dynamic-capacity' -> OK §8.4.2.3.4 2). No DOC-A.1-60 row (not required; but DOC-A.1-62's cell asserts 'the same ... determination item 60 records for a dynamic-capacity table (CobolDynTable<T>.MaxOccurrences)' — a cross-reference to a row that does not exist). Code: the determination IS fixed — MaxOccurrences = 0x3FFFFFFF; a receiving subscript past it raises EC-BOUND-TABLE-LIMIT (probe: MOVE 1 TO E(2000000000) -> 'EC-BOUND-TABLE-LIMIT (fatal) ... implementor maximum (1073741823)'). Two edges fail: (1) GR2's EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT is never set for a dynamic table — probe with >>TURN EC-ALL CHECKING ON: E(3) at capacity 2 (sending) and E(0) both return the seed '07' with EXCEPTION-STATUS blank, while a fixed OCCURS 5 table's E(0) raises EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT; owned by kb/Work/PB1268 (open, names RefSending/RefReceiving). (2) 'may be affected by the availability of runtime resources': a growth below MaxOccurrences that exhausts memory dies with a raw .NET 'Out of memory.' (probe oom.cob, DOTNET_GCHeapHardLimit=2GB, MOVE 'A' TO E(1000000000)) instead of a bounded maximum; owned by kb/Work/PB1410 (open). Editions: OCCURS DYNAMIC is 2014+ (compiler gates it at 85 — char_neg_occurs_dyn85). No spec-derived test pins the maximum itself -> PARTIAL.

A.1 item 61: 'Dynamic-capacity table (physical allocation). This item is required. This item does not have to be documented' (8.5.1.9). §8.5.1.9.1: 'The size, location, and time of physical allocation of a dynamic-capacity table are implementor-defined.' cite.py --check 8.5.1.9.1 'The size, location, and time of physical allocation of a dynamic-capacity table are implementor-defined' -> OK §8.5.1.9.1 (General). No DOC-A.1-61 row (not required). Code: out-of-line managed array per table instance, allocated at construction (>=4 slots, opened at FROM/VALUE capacity), grown by doubling in GrowTo on demand (capped at MaxOccurrences), shrink by SetCapacity keeps the slots (licensed by the §8.5.1.9.4 NOTE) and GrowTo re-seeds re-created occurrences. The allocation-failure edge is unhandled: Array.Resize's OutOfMemoryException escapes GrowTo uncaught, so a growth the runtime cannot allocate kills the process ('Out of memory.', probe oom.cob under a 2GB GC heap limit) instead of §8.5.1.9.6 GR2's EC-BOUND-TABLE-LIMIT ('higher than the maximum capacity of the table based on the resources available at runtime'); owned by kb/Work/PB1410 (open). Allocation strategy verified by reading; failure path diverges -> PARTIAL.

A.1 item 63: 'Dynamic-length elementary items (structure if dynamic-length-structure-name-1 is not specified). This item is required. This item need not be documented' (8.5.1.10.2). §13.18.19.3 SR3: 'If dynamic-length-structure-name-1 is not specified, the structure of the dynamic-length elementary item is defined by the implementor.' cite.py --check 13.18.19.3 'If dynamic-length-structure-name-1 is not specified, the structure of the dynamic-length elementary item is defined by the implementor.' -> OK §13.18.19.3 3). No row (not required); D-DL3 says the item IS a native string with no addressable byte image. Code: in storage the default structure is the native string (verified); but at the one boundary where a structure becomes observable — a record image — the unstructured item is inlined as bare content with no length or delimiter, so the structure is not recoverable: probe dl.cob (FD R. 05 D1 PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH. 05 D2 PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH.; MOVE 'ABC' TO D1, 'DE' TO D2; WRITE; READ) -> file bytes 05 00 00 00 'ABCDE', READ yields D1=[ABCDE] D2=[] (wrong answer). Same mechanism as kb/Work/PB1094 (open; the DELIMITED arm), row owned by kb/Work/PB991 (open, SR-13.18.19.3-3). Reported as a findings.json arm of that mechanism. Editions: dynamic-length items exist from 2014 (Annex E.3.3 item 17 lists only the 2023 SET enhancement to them); the compiler accepts the probe at --std 2014 with the same wrong result.
